sql:
WITH female_salary AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, c.gender, d.A11 as avg_salary
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
min_max_salary AS (
    SELECT MIN(avg_salary) as min_avg, MAX(avg_salary) as max_avg
    FROM female_salary
),
oldest_lowest AS (
    SELECT fs.client_id, fs.birth_date, fs.avg_salary
    FROM female_salary fs
    CROSS JOIN min_max_salary mms
    WHERE fs.avg_salary = mms.min_avg
    ORDER BY fs.birth_date ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    ol.client_id,
    ol.birth_date,
    ol.avg_salary as lowest_avg_salary,
    mms.max_avg as highest_avg_salary,
    (mms.max_avg - ol.avg_salary) as gap,
    a.account_id
FROM oldest_lowest ol
CROSS JOIN min_max_salary mms
JOIN disp d ON ol.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
